build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using gtn Graph, union, and closure operations
build_token_graph: build a token transition model graph with one or more consecutive word piece emissions using gtn
compose_word_decomposition: compose a word graph with a lexicon graph to compute all possible word decompositions using gtn compose
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token and decomposition graphs using gtn project_input and remove
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence level loss by intersecting emissions with alignment graphs and subtracting forward scores
